title: Download selected authorized inventory-aging page as PDF
description: An inventory user downloads the selected bounded stock-aging page as a paginated Chinese PDF. Reuse ERP-135 stock-query authorization and preview, existing PDFsharp and shared SimHei resolver. Show fixed age buckets, base-unit quantities, CNY cost currency and unknown age/cost evidence explicitly; split wide selected-column sets across pages without clipping. Missing font fails explicitly; HTTP audit records read-only download. Development only: no migration, production SQL, real database execution, arbitrary model SQL, writes, secret/.env change or deployment. Verify PDF and safe build/test.
acceptance_criteria: PDF endpoint reuses authorized bounded stock-aging preview, rechecks stock-query permission and all filters before any bytes are returned.
PDFsharp renders selected fields, fixed age buckets, Chinese labels, CNY and explicit unknown values across row/column pages without clipping; shared SimHei resolver fails if font unavailable.

Designer offers PDF download and visible empty/authorization/font failures; tests inspect PDF signature, selected fields, page bounds, unknowns, font failure and no writes; document font prerequisite.
